resources.string: Give a team member a clearly scoped task and review their report.
Create a goal first. This records an objective; it does not start work.
This creates a proposed read-only report task. Other task types remain available in advanced work.
Create a goal in this project

Approval may start work if scheduling is enabled. It does not grant permissions. Confirm the assigned member, whole-project read scope, inherited network permissions, criteria and reservation before continuing.
Read-only report authorization and contract approval are separate. Approval may allow the scheduler to dispatch when enabled.
Creating a proposal does not grant permissions or start work. Authorization and contract approval are separate actions.
Reviewer availability is checked by the server during authorization.
Whole-project read only · existing network permissions · reservation %1$s tokens / %2$s cost units (currency not provided). Reservations are not a hard spending limit.
Reservation: %1$s tokens · %2$s cost units. Currency not provided; this is not a hard spending limit.
Model declaration: %1$s. This is not an acceptance decision.
Record %1$s for this candidate and criterion? This is your manual decision.
Request outcome is not confirmed. Retry uses the same request.
Request recorded. Refresh for current status.
The work changed. Refresh and review again before a new request.
Request not confirmed: %1$s. Retry uses the same request.
Request recorded, but refresh failed: %1$s. Refresh details before another action.
Without an account-bound scope, an unconfirmed request cannot be restored after the connection changes. Record the request identity before leaving.
This work type is available in advanced work.
Ask the team to inspect the project and prepare a report.
What would you like the team to check?
Saving a draft does not start work. You can review and decide when to start.
Choose who should help. Access is checked before work can start.
Which plan should contain this task?
The server checks this person’s access before starting.
No available reviewer is connected. Add or connect a suitable member first.
The report answers the request and identifies supporting evidence and unresolved points.
Review the scope and decide whether to start.
Before starting, set the amount to reserve for this task.
The service has not provided a currency. Actual usage or cost may differ; this reservation is not a hard spending limit.
The team can read this project; existing network permissions apply.
Allow the team to read the project
If scheduling is enabled, work may begin after you confirm.
Unable to identify this project. Reconnect and refresh before saving.
The saved budget is incomplete. Review it before starting.
Save both values or clear both before starting.
%1$d action(s) have unconfirmed external outcome — inspect receipt before retrying
Nothing in this bucket right now.
Speech capture was unclear. No changes were written or dispatched.
Voice cannot authorize writes, merges, sends, or privilege actions. Verify target and digest below before confirming.
Reading a report does not record acceptance. Each decision applies only to this candidate and version.
Report or evidence is unavailable or unverified; a formal decision cannot be submitted.
Related work could not be checked completely. Choose a work item from activity or reconnect.
Several reports await review. Choose a work item:
Requesting another version is subject to the existing attempt limit and authorization. The returned decision remains in history; a new candidate requires a new review.
Choose the maximum attempts for this report. Budget limits are reviewed before starting; no limit is implied when none is set.
The new attempt is ready but still needs your authorization. Existing contract and budget limits apply.
This work uses the responsibility authorization; check its policy and current status.
The authority for the new attempt could not be verified. Refresh before continuing.
Contract limits — tokens: %1$s · cost: %2$s (— means not set)
The existing attempt limit is exhausted or unavailable. Create a separately authorized report if further work is needed.
No independent review receipt is available or verified.
Source run: %1$s · harness: %2$s · provider: %3$s · run state: %4$s
Review work: %1$s · reviewer: %2$s · run: %3$s · harness: %4$s · provider: %5$s · run state: %6$s
A review receipt does not establish current authorization or owner acceptance. Missing values are unverified.
More records exist; this view is limited.
Review work: %1$s · reviewer: %2$s · state: %3$s · control: %4$s · contract: %5$s · execution: %6$s
Connection availability is separate from execution state. A snapshot does not copy work to another machine or authorize a restart.
No execution binding is available; execution is unverified.
Snapshot request for work %1$s is unconfirmed. Retry uses the same request.
Snapshot freshness does not prove that an older run stopped, that a new run is safe, or that transfer was authorized.
Work access: %1$s · allowed paths: %2$s (— is empty or unavailable)
Candidate allowed paths: %1$s (— is empty or unavailable)
Review link: %1$s · reviewer access: %2$s. This is a current-context check, not future authorization.
Source and reviewer machine identity is unverified.
Choose a bound report member (permissions are verified by the server):
No bound report member is currently available.

The current project could not be verified. Reconnect and refresh.
Create and formally accept the first report before enabling a weekly schedule. A wake does not prove execution.
Eligibility is unavailable or the first report has not been formally accepted.
Every %1$s at %2$s in %3$s. Confirm this schedule?
Request one report under this responsibility and its existing authorization? A request is not proof that work started.
Change and risk comparison are unavailable or not comparable; no change is inferred.
Report text is a model statement, not a verified business fact.
Run and stop facts are unavailable. Reconnect and recheck before taking action.
Expected run: %1$s · observation: %2$s · run state: %3$s · observed: %4$s
Control request: %1$s · stop observation: %2$s. A request alone does not prove termination.
A matching run was observed but its binding still needs verification.
Outcome unknown (%1$s). Do not assume the previous run stopped; recheck its evidence.
Budget reservation and actual usage are unavailable.
Reservation: %1$s · reserved tokens: %2$s, cost: %3$s · settled tokens: %4$s, cost: %5$s. — means unknown or unavailable; estimates are not a spending cap.
External receipts and side effects are unverified unless tied to an authorized operation.
Comparison basis unavailable or not comparable: %1$s
These are model statements shown for review. Differences and business facts are not independently verified; missing risks do not prove none exist.
